name: codech-web-hardening
description: Codech Web Hardening — secure and stabilise a live web server (WordPress/PHP behind Caddy, nginx, Apache or cPanel, usually fronted by Cloudflare) without taking it down. Break-glass-first safety, capacity triage, proxy-log fail2ban, origin lockdown, caching, self-healing watchdog, and the shared-IP rules for campaign/event spikes.
